alert_bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: increased session stalls and 502s for hosted generation in eu-west-1. Alert fired for p99 latency > 2s and error-rate > 1%. Paging oncall.
sam_oncall: seeing many sessions stuck waiting on kv-store read for prefix cache. Grafana panel shows `kv_read_latency_p99` jump to ~1200ms.
mina_sre: adding traces. Correlation: a small subset of keys returning inconsistent empty payloads, causing downstream retries and session lock contention. Sample trace: `fetch_prefix(key=org:1234:conv:9876) -> empty -> retry -> lock-wait`.
carlos_infra: checking Redis cluster: same-key misses, partial failover events recorded around 2026-04-28T08:12Z. One replica promoted briefly during cluster rebalancer window.
agnes_prod: status page posted: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1772500000  Impact: increased latency and transient errors for hosted gen in EU. Mitigation in progress.
cs_team: we have a couple of high-priority customer reports about stalled chat sessions; notifying them and linking status page.
sam_oncall: short-term mitigation: add retry-backoff and skip-on-empty for prefix-cache reads to avoid lock thrash. Applying feature-flag to 2 canary pods now.
mina_sre: after canary change, observed fewer stuck sessions and p99 trimmed by ~40% on canaries. Continuing to monitor.
carlos_infra: repro steps for failover scenario captured. Will revert the recent rebalancer tweak and run a controlled rolling rebalance with draining to prevent split-brain promotions.
agnes_prod: status note updated: "Mitigation applied on canary nodes; rolling to remaining nodes. Investigating root cause in Redis rebalancer." Draft customer advisory in progress.
mina_sre: postmortem owner: mina_sre. Action items: 1) add guard for empty-prefix responses, 2) add alert for replica-promote events during rebalancer runs, 3) add canary gate for rebalancer changes.
cs_team: sent interim customer advisory and offered to assist impacted customers; no data loss reported.
sam_oncall: final update: rolled mitigation to all pods in eu-west-1; read latencies and error-rate back to baseline. Will watch for 24h.
alert_bot: RESOLVED at 1772500600  incident closed. Postmortem request: https://redwood.internal/pm/1772500000-postmortem
